subject: SIG intake: custody ledger and min-privilege snapshot for Midland Health
content:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@midlandhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@midlandhealth.com
Date: 2026-04-15 09:12 -07:00
Subject: SIG intake — access custody ledger & min-priv snapshot request

Hi Stephanie,

We are working through the SIG intake for Midland Health (control set A2 — identity & access). Our auditors have asked for the following artifacts to complete the access controls section:

- SCIM delta export for the last 90 days (creation/deprovision events, including source system attribute values)
- A sample of SAML assertions for typical login flows (including NameID, attributes mapping)
- Role-to-owner snapshot (CSV) showing role definitions and current owners/approvers
- Evidence of least-privilege reviews (notes, timestamps) and any recent role pruning decisions
- Example session-auth logs for elevated actions (audit-friendly sample)

We prefer a secure SFTP drop or a Google Drive folder with restricted access. Can you confirm Redwood can provide these items and the expected turnaround?

Also, please indicate any rows we should expect to redact (PII) so we surface only what auditors need.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Midland Health — Vendor Risk & Compliance

--

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@midlandhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-15 11:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — access custody ledger & min-priv snapshot request

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list. Happy to own the intake on our side. Quick proposed plan:

1) Scope confirm (by EOD 2026-04-16): we will map each artifact you asked for to a deliverable label (SCIM_DELTA, SAML_SAMPLE, ROLE_SNAPSHOT, LEAST_PRIV_NOTES, SESSION_SAMPLE).
2) Delivery method: please share SFTP creds OR create a Drive folder and grant redwood-inference-compliance@redwood.com (suggested) by 2026-04-18.
3) Workback & timeline: initial zip with redaction guidance and a role_owner_snapshot CSV by 2026-04-20; full SCIM delta and saml samples by 2026-04-22. If auditors need faster turnaround on a specific item, flag it and we will prioritize.
4) Sensitive fields: we plan to mask user emails and employee IDs in any shared SCIM extracts unless you request otherwise. Please confirm allowed redaction policy.

Attachments we will produce (stubs): role_owner_snapshot_2026-03.csv, scim_delta_manifest.txt (filename map). Final packages will be delivered as MIDLAND_scim_delta_2026-03.zip and MIDLAND_saml_assertions_sample.eml.

Next step — can we set a 30-minute call tomorrow (2026-04-16) at 10:00 PT to walk the handoff and exchange the SFTP info? I’ve cc'd Jonas (IAM lead) and Laura (customer success) to assist.\n
Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

--

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@midlandhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@midlandhealth.com
Date: 2026-04-16 08:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — access custody ledger & min-priv snapshot request

Thanks Stephanie — call confirmed for 2026-04-16 10:00 PT. I will ask our infra team to provision an SFTP drop and will send creds separately via our vault.

Regarding redaction: auditors want to see unique user identifiers but accept pseudonymized values (hashes) for PHI/PII. Please replace email addresses with a stable hash and blank employee_ssn fields. Role names and owners should remain intact.

We will upload the following files to the SFTP:
- MIDLAND_scim_delta_2026-03.zip (contains events CSVs and manifest)
- MIDLAND_saml_assertions_sample.eml (5 sample assertion flows)
- role_owner_snapshot_2026-03.csv

I will also include a short readme.txt describing any known gaps. If you need us to redact before uploading, let me know — otherwise we will provide raw extracts and you can handle redaction on your side.

Elaine

--

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@midlandhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-20 17:08 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — access custody ledger & min-priv snapshot request

Elaine — confirmed receipt of the SFTP notification and the three files yesterday. I pulled the sample packages and forwarded them to our security team for review (Vivek is looped). Key notes from our intake review:

- We will apply stable hashing to email columns in SCIM exports and remove any free-text PHI from notes columns.
- SAML assertion samples are complete; we will extract attribute maps and provide an annotated sample for auditors.
- Role_owner_snapshot looks good — we will add owner contact email hashes and a last-reviewed timestamp column.

Next actions: Vivek will post redaction guidance and the annotated saml map in the Drive folder by 2026-04-22, and I will upload the final MIDLAND_redacted_package_2026-04-22.zip.

If you prefer us to do only metadata-level redaction and return raw files to you for archival, say so now; otherwise we will proceed with the redacted package as noted.

Thanks for the smooth handoff — will follow up with the Drive link and HubSpot deal update once the package is uploaded.

Best,
Stephanie
Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: MIDLAND_scim_delta_2026-03.zip (zip) — MIDLAND_saml_assertions_sample.eml (eml) — role_owner_snapshot_2026-03.csv (csv)
